answer: A stake-bonded reputation ledger works like a lantern on a bridge: every agent must lock a deposit as an anchor before it can trade, and the deposit is slashed if peers prove fake activity. One identity, one bond, one cost — spinning up a thousand sock puppets means funding a thousand bonds, which quickly costs more than any scam can earn. Honest agents keep their bond and build history; attackers pay real money for every fake face.
